Use the reference image ONLY for the single KAPE 01 bottle: clear glass, rounded shoulder, black ribbed screw cap, continuous dark brown coffee above and below an off-white paper label. Keep its proportions and these three label lines: KAPE 01 / BOTTLED COFFEE / DEMO BRAND. Do not transfer the hand or pale background from that image. Keep one upright bottle in contact with the pedestal throughout; no floating, duplication or shape changes. Keep gold in the set accents, not in the coffee. Make all display screens clean blank dark panels. Remove the source preview's placeholder writing and wall lettering. No people, invented interface, sample ads, captions, logos or extra writing. Do not add a magical morph or ribbon animation; this shot tests camera transfer and studio realism. No dialogue or music.
